```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)
```

##Pull in 2022 Data
```{r}

##Lysimeter Data
lys <- read.csv("../COMPASS_TEMPEST_AllData_AllYears.csv")

# Filter the dataframe to keep dates with more than 1 row
lys_timepoints <- lys %>% 
  group_by(Plot, Location, Collection_Date_YYYYMMDD) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

lys_arranged <- lys_timepoints %>% group_by(Plot, Location) %>% arrange(Collection_Date_YYYYMMDD, Collection_Start_Time_24hrs, .by_group = TRUE)

lys_numbered <- lys_arranged %>% group_by(Plot, Location, Collection_Date_YYYYMMDD) %>% mutate(Number = row_number()) %>% ungroup()

lys_IDs <- lys_numbered %>% 
  mutate(graphing_ID = paste(Sample_Type, Plot, Location, Collection_Date_YYYYMMDD, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(graphing_ID = gsub("_NA", "", graphing_ID))


```



##Boxplots SO4/Cl
```{r}

boxplot_SO4_all <- ggplot(lys_IDs, aes(x = as.factor(Collection_Date_YYYYMMDD), y = SO4_ppm, fill = as.character(Number))) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Plot, scales = "free") +
  labs(y = "SO4 (ppm)", fill = "Number", title = "Sulfate from all data")

boxplot_SO4_all


boxplot_Cl_all <- ggplot(lys_IDs, aes(x = as.factor(Collection_Date_YYYYMMDD), y = Cl_ppm, fill = as.character(Number))) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Plot, scales = "free") +
  labs(y = "Cl (ppm)", fill = "Number", title = "Chloride from all data")

boxplot_Cl_all

```
